blueprint.primary_competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts
blueprint.content_focus: IL2RG common-gamma-chain cytokine signaling in X-linked SCID

item.vignette: A 4-month-old boy has persistent oral candidiasis, chronic diarrhea, and Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia. Flow cytometry shows profoundly decreased T cells, preserved B-cell numbers, and profoundly decreased NK cells. Genetic testing identifies a hemizygous loss-of-function variant in IL2RG.
item.lead_in: Loss of signaling through which pair of cytokines most directly explains the absent T-cell and NK-cell lineages in this patient?

options.E: Granulocyte colony-stimulating factor and granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor

item.difficulty_basis: Expert estimate only; requires mapping the T-B+NK- phenotype to IL2RG and then distinguishing the developmental roles of IL-7 and IL-15.
item.tested_construct: Complete IL2RG loss causes T-B+NK- X-SCID through loss of common-gamma-chain signaling, particularly IL-7 for T-cell and IL-15 for NK-cell development

explanation.key_explanation: IL2RG encodes the common gamma chain shared by several cytokine receptors. Complete loss of function causes the classic T-B+NK- X-SCID phenotype. GeneReviews specifically links the developmental arrest of T and NK lymphocytes to loss of IL-7 and IL-15 signaling, respectively.

distractor_explanations.A: Correct. IL-7 signaling is critical for T-lineage development, and IL-15 signaling is critical for NK-lineage development through receptors that use the common gamma chain.
distractor_explanations.B: IL-4 uses the common gamma chain in one receptor configuration, but IL-13 does not; this pair does not explain the characteristic simultaneous loss of T and NK lineages.
distractor_explanations.C: IL-12 and interferon-gamma form a macrophage/Th1 host-defense axis and do not produce the classic T-B+NK- X-SCID pattern.
distractor_explanations.D: BAFF and APRIL primarily support B-cell survival and differentiation; B-cell numbers are preserved in classic X-SCID.
distractor_explanations.E: G-CSF and GM-CSF regulate myeloid development and are not the defining IL2RG-dependent developmental signals for T and NK cells.

explanation.educational_objective: Complete IL2RG loss causes T-B+NK- X-linked SCID because common-gamma-chain cytokine signaling is disrupted; loss of IL-7 signaling arrests T-cell development and loss of IL-15 signaling arrests NK-cell development.

evidence_map.claim: Complete IL2RG loss produces T-B+NK- X-SCID through lack of IL-7 and IL-15 signaling.
